title: Copper ore

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Copper ore can be refined into Copper in a Smelter.
Two Copper can be further processed at a Forge with Tin to yield Bronze.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text:
It can be mined from Copper deposits which can be found in Black Forest biomes using any Pickaxe. Such deposits have subtle bronze-colored streaks that reflect the sunlight. It is the only visual feature that distinguishes them from typical stone boulders.
Copper deposits are generated in a large size which extends down into the ground, so digging deep underneath the surface is necessary to fully extract a single deposit.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• A way of farming Copper is to dig the earth all around the deposit until it crumbles on itself into Copper ores.
• Like other metals, Copper ore cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.
• The attacks of a Troll, despite being harmless to normal terrain, cause immense damage to Copper ore. If the player has no pickaxe or simply yearns for a change from their usual monotonous mining method, a troll can make for a great alternative.

Copper ore

Type: Ore | Internal ID: CopperOre | Source: Copper deposit | Usage: Makes, Copper | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No

Introduction. Copper ore can be refined into Copper in a Smelter.
Two Copper can be further processed at a Forge with Tin to yield Bronze.

Availability. It can be mined from Copper deposits which can be found in Black Forest biomes using any Pickaxe. Such deposits have subtle bronze-colored streaks that reflect the sunlight. It is the only visual feature that distinguishes them from typical stone boulders.
Copper deposits are generated in a large size which extends down into the ground, so digging deep underneath the surface is necessary to fully extract a single deposit.

Notes. • A way of farming Copper is to dig the earth all around the deposit until it crumbles on itself into Copper ores.
• Like other metals, Copper ore cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.
• The attacks of a Troll, despite being harmless to normal terrain, cause immense damage to Copper ore. If the player has no pickaxe or simply yearns for a change from their usual monotonous mining method, a troll can make for a great alternative.
